lines.trans: Hello, Samsonov.
I have a meeting with Putin today.
It is a big secret, no one should know.
What are you saying? What Putin?
We only have one Putin in the country.
Did you come for your things?
How are you feeling right now, Vanya?
I feel bad, really terrible.
I need to prepare for the meeting urgently.
Are you joking, Samson? Is that a defense mechanism?
No, I am a true people's candidate!
Do not cover up your grief with bravado.
We are worrying about you very much.
There is no need to worry about me!
Alright, get out of here, I am very busy.
